purpose: Hostile-wording paraphrase sets for preregistration v7 check W. Copied VERBATIM from notes/preregistration_v7_robustness.md, which was written before any W run generated a token. This file is not hash-locked in manifest.json, but its contents are fixed by that preregistration: only `incorrect` (used for the accurate-arm incorrect branch, the malfunctioning-arm message and the symmetric-onset failure message) and `correct` (the accurate-arm correct branch) are replaced. Every other string in configs/conditions.json -- neutral tone, washout, correction, measured-trial -- is untouched, and configs/conditions.json itself is never modified: the override is applied to an in-memory copy of the frozen conditions.
